name: @pipeworx/mcp-harvard-art

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Harvard Art Museums collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to object), titles, creators, dates and image links.

_apiKey.description: Harvard Art Museums API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

tools.name: object
tools.description: Fetch full details for one Harvard Art Museums item by id — a Harvard Art Museums object id (numeric, from search).

_apiKey.description: Harvard Art Museums API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-harvard-art forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the harvard-art pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
